description: Stocktaking overview: without sessionId, all stocktaking sessions with live progress; with sessionId, the per-location and per-counter breakdown of that session. "pending" = not yet counted, "missing" = counted as absent: a CLOSED session can have missing items (missing > 0 while pending = 0 is a completed count that found items missing, not a contradiction). Each session carries a `name`; its `id` is the handle for the sessionId argument.
name: stocktaking_status

sessions.description: All stocktaking sessions — only in the no-argument mode

totals.description: Org-wide counters for one session (expected, confirmed, …)

title: Stocktaking status
